experiment: E2 PILOT of idea #6 (aligned-VAE probe) and #7 (VAE double-reconstruction ratio), docs/04-phase4-plan.md Amendment 8; does not count toward the stop rule
vae_io: uint8 -> float32 [-1,1] -> encode -> latent_dist.mode() (the posterior MEAN, deterministic) -> decode -> (y+1)/2 clamped to [0,1] -> quantized to uint8 (np.rint) before saving / re-encoding; fp32, TF32 off; GPU batch <= 4 (shared GPU: OOM -> batch halved)

timing_gate.cut: 30 fakes per generator and 150 natives in the #7 test set

features: 004 pipeline: DINOv2-base (HF facebook/dinov2-base), secondary backbone blocks 4/8/12 CLS+mean, primary = last 1536 columns, 224 center crop, batch 20, TF32 off; existing images from cached 004 features (load_features_aligned, subdir pilot / pilot_fov512)
six_A: probe on train reals (297: 99 native + 99 WA + 99 FBH) vs aligned fakes (594 = 297 x 2 VAEs), trained on CLEAN features, balanced logistic, grouped CV (group = source real sha256); evaluated at clean and jpeg75_resize05 on test natives (358) vs ALL 120 fakes per generator (005 LOGO convention)
six_B: 005 A0: b0_train (99 natives + generator fakes) LOGO, grouped CV (group = sha256), class_weight balanced
six_C: B's LOGO training rows + the 594 aligned fakes (group = source real sha256). C_all_reals = C plus the 198 WA/FBH train reals (sensitivity)

six_criteria.C_vs_B: +0.02 at jpeg75_resize05 only if B LOGO-macro at jpeg75_resize05 <= 0.96, else no headroom / uninformative

seven.x: the conditioned test image (clean: the 512 crop; jpeg75_resize05: the 256x256 image after the condition), float [0,1]
seven.ratio: ||x-x1||_2 / ||x1-x2||_2 over all pixels in [0,1] float space; min over the 2 VAEs; fake-score = -ratio (fixed, never flipped)
seven.baseline_single: ||x-x1||_2, min over the 2 VAEs; fake-score = -min (lower error = fake, AEROBLADE premise, fixed); L2 instead of LPIPS
seven.texture: mean |4-neighbour Laplacian| of the grayscale 224 center crop of the conditioned image; sign chosen on calib natives vs train-split fakes (calib has no fakes)
seven.test_set: split == test: 358 VISION natives (25 devices) vs 60 fakes x 6 generators
seven.PASS: ratio macro AUROC clean >= single-pass + 0.05 AND >= 0.65 at jpeg75_resize05 AND beats texture (both conditions); FAIL otherwise; UNINFORMATIVE if the clean AUROC CI includes 0.5; label arm orig

bootstrap: lib/metrics.bootstrap_weights: reals by device, fakes by image stratified per generator, one plan shared by all methods (paired); texture check on train reals vs aligned fakes: device clusters moved together (aligned fake carries its source real's device)

d008.vae: CUDA vs CPU, 32 fixed images (16 native + 16 fake, test, orig, clean), max |dpixel| of float output <= 1e-3 (x1 and x2)
d008.probe: 32 aligned fakes, DINOv2 features CUDA(cache) vs CPU, scaled |dF| <= 1e-3 and |dlogit| <= 1e-3 for probes A and C_full
